name: CNPJ enrichment
description: Looks up public company data by CNPJ (BrasilAPI and ReceitaWS) and fills the chosen fields, recording the source of each value.

source.label: Data source
source.help: BrasilAPI is the main one; ReceitaWS allows only 3 lookups per minute

options.brasilapi_then_receitaws: BrasilAPI, with ReceitaWS as a fallback
options.receitaws: ReceitaWS only (limit of 3 lookups per minute)

cnpj_field.label: CNPJ field
cnpj_field.help: Company text field holding the CNPJ; without it, the CNPJ is typed on lookup

automatic.label: Allow automatic enrichment
automatic.help: Only with this on can the automation action "Enrich company by CNPJ" fill fields without a click

company.title: CNPJ enrichment
company.description: Look up the company's public data from the Brazilian Federal Revenue (through BrasilAPI or ReceitaWS), compare with the current values and choose what to apply. Nothing is filled without your confirmation.
company.dataNotice: Only the CNPJ is sent to the public source.

history.title: Fields filled by enrichment
history.emptyDescription: Fields applied from the CNPJ appear here with the source and date.
